criteria: The exact minimum CdkTableModule public root export supplies the same four outlet directive objects through its existing exports. Full authenticated declaration and runtime module metadata agree for every export. Remove four unused bindings from table.ts (identical whole diagnostic JavaScript emit) and four redundant explicit imports from the legacy NgModule; its existing public CdkTableModule import preserves the template directive scope. No outlet replacement, template/selector/provider/style or CDK implementation change is made. This closes only these eight removed direct imports; other private boundaries and table/manual-constructor/native/packed contracts remain open.

reviews.decision: The frozen HeaderRowOutlet occurrence at legacy-table/table.ts is removed from the maintained source. The source never referenced this imported class outside its unused import; complete emitted component JavaScript is unchanged after all four unused outlet imports are removed. No selector, template, provider, table parent, row/outlet implementation or style behavior changes. The public module retains the outlet directive scope on both actual minimum versions. Close this obsolete direct private binding only; runtime/template/AOT/packed and all other table/DI/manual-constructor obligations remain separate. Subsequent table outlet ownership repair changes only inert outlet bindings and their internal protocol; the historical unchanged-emit statement above belongs to its original captured subject. The unused direct outlet imports remain absent on this source. Fresh tagged outlet/section/ownership execution, both minimum declaration proofs and genuine public-parent diagnostics support the current binding; native/packed and original table manual construction remain unqualified. The later maintainer-delegated table constructor decision changes only TypeScript construction. Fresh seven factory/parent/subclass/manual-rejection cases and strict minimum declarations pass; inline template and table HTML/SCSS remain byte-identical to the prior captured subject. All four direct outlet imports remain absent; no additional frozen use closure or native/packed qualification is inferred. Subsequent metadata repair replaces only the deprecated Default identifier with stable Eager at the same numeric1, with exact whole-source before/after caps and public enum-value proof. Allfourunused outlet imports remain absent, and no table template/provider/outlet/constructor/body change occurs. No new lifecycle/outlet or native/packed/floor clearance is inferred.
